notes: Anchored on the script, the table and the write-up (Online_Write-up_1-9.docx: F(1,124)=0.001, p=.97, d=0.01). The survey's worry about the script writing to column 60 does not bite: read.spss splits a very long string record into extra columns, so the frame has 59 columns and Exclude lands at column 60; the exclusion works as intended (by accident). Three side discrepancies, none touching F or p: (1) group labels: the codebook says 0 = no hand-washing (68 after exclusions), the write-up says hand-washing n = 68 and control n = 58, so the sign of d (+.006 by the codebook, washers slightly MORE severe; -.006 by the write-up) depends on which label is right; the table's Direction.R = 'same' follows the write-up. (2) The write-up says eight participants were removed; the data give six (132 -> 126). (3) The codebook gives a 0-9 vignette scale; the data and write-up use 1-7.
